methodology: All figures are monthly costs in 2026 US dollars for a single person with a modest-but-comfortable lifestyle (mid-market 1-bedroom rental, moderate dining out, no car payment in transportation). Rent for every location was cross-checked against at least two independent sources (RentCafe, Zumper, Zillow, Rent.com, Apartments.com, Numbeo, HUD FMR, Home.co.uk); where sources disagreed by more than 20% the median of the reported figures was used and noted. Non-rent categories are anchored on Numbeo city pages (utilities, transit passes, meal prices, retrieved July 2026) and MIT Living Wage Calculator county data (food, transportation, medical baselines, Feb 2026 update). Tokyo converted at 162.4 JPY/USD and Cambridge UK at 1.34 USD/GBP (mid-July 2026 rates); annualGrowthRate uses the latest BLS metro CPI-U 12-month change (or national statistics for Tokyo/UK), defaulting to 0.03 where no metro series exists.

sacramento_ca.notes: Rent sources clustered $1,475-1,689 (RentCafe $1,689, Rent.com $1,612, Zumper $1,480, Numbeo $1,541-2,087); car-dependent city so transportation reflects CA gas (~$5.60/gal), insurance, and maintenance; growth uses US/West CPI proxy since BLS publishes no Sacramento metro series.
